content.value: Consider à semiconductor sample with conductivity σ and a refractive index n. Show that the absorption coefficient due to free carrier absorption (due to conductivity) is given by $\dot { \alpha } = ( 1 / c \varepsilon _ { 0 } ) \sigma / n$ , where the symbols have their usual meaning.
